T1.implementation_approach: Create a user-friendly interface with search, filter, and categorization features using a frontend framework like React.
T1.notes: Ensure responsive design for compatibility across devices.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful APIs to handle problem data retrieval, creation, and updates using a backend framework like Node.js or Django.
T2.notes: Focus on scalability and secure API endpoints.

T3.implementation_approach: Design a relational database schema to store problem details, tags, and metadata using MySQL or PostgreSQL.
T3.notes: Optimize for efficient querying and indexing.

T4.implementation_approach: Build an intuitive UI for users to write, test, and submit code using a code editor component like Monaco Editor.
T4.notes: Include syntax highlighting and error feedback.

T5.implementation_approach: Create a backend service to handle code submissions, execute them in a secure sandbox, and return results.
T5.notes: Ensure proper isolation and resource limits for execution.

T6.implementation_approach: Set up a containerized infrastructure using Docker to securely execute and evaluate user-submitted code.
T6.notes: Implement monitoring and logging for debugging.

T7.implementation_approach: Design a profile page UI to display user details, activity, and achievements using a frontend framework.

T8.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to manage user data, including authentication, profile updates, and activity tracking.
T8.notes: Ensure secure handling of sensitive user information.

T9.implementation_approach: Set up a database schema to store user profiles, preferences, and activity logs.
T9.notes: Use encryption for sensitive data like passwords.

T10.implementation_approach: Create a dynamic leaderboard UI to display rankings, scores, and filters for different categories.
T10.notes: Ensure real-time updates for a competitive experience.

T11.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to calculate and serve leaderboard data based on user performance metrics.

T12.implementation_approach: Design an interactive UI for hints and tutorials with multimedia support and step-by-step guidance.
T12.notes: Ensure accessibility and ease of navigation.

T13.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to manage hints and tutorials, including CRUD operations and user progress tracking.

T14.implementation_approach: Set up a database to store hints, tutorials, and user progress data.
T14.notes: Optimize for fast retrieval of tutorial content.

T15.implementation_approach: Perform end-to-end testing of the problem library, including UI, backend, and database integration.
T15.notes: Use automated testing tools like Selenium or Postman.

T16.implementation_approach: Test the code submission and evaluation system for correctness, security, and performance under load.
T16.notes: Simulate various edge cases and malicious inputs.

T17.implementation_approach: Validate user profile features, including data updates, authentication, and activity tracking.

T18.implementation_approach: Test leaderboard functionality for accuracy, real-time updates, and scalability under high user traffic.

T19.implementation_approach: Test hints and tutorials for content accuracy, UI responsiveness, and user progress tracking.

T20.implementation_approach: Deploy the platform using a cloud provider like AWS or Azure with CI/CD pipelines for seamless updates.
T20.notes: Ensure proper monitoring and rollback mechanisms.
